newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Columbia coal restart unknown.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Columbia coal restart unknown.

text.p: No restart date has yet been set for Wisconsin Power and Light Co's 500 megawatt coal-fired electricity unit shut Wednesday for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"The issue is temporary but we have not yet set a restart date," spokesman Todd VanFossen said Thursday.
The shut unit is one of two 500 megawatt units located near Portage, Wis. The other unit was operating normally, VanFossen said.
The unit was shut for a "slagging problem," the spokesman said, adding he did not have more details about the nature of the necessary repairs to correct the problem.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
